notes: CDC Q fever diagnostic guidance was reread for routine blood-culture negativity and the chronic-Q-fever phase I IgG pattern.
CDC clinical guidance was reread for livestock exposure, valvular disease as a chronic-Q-fever risk factor, and endocarditis as the predominant chronic manifestation.
Peer-reviewed mechanistic literature was checked for Coxiella replication in an acidic phagolysosome-like Coxiella-containing vacuole.
Official USMLE Content Outline (2026) page 33 explicitly lists Q fever (Coxiella burnetii).

blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts

duplicate_gate.diagnosis: Chronic Q fever endocarditis due to Coxiella burnetii

claim_audit.exposure: Goat/sheep and parturition exposure is epidemiologically appropriate for aerosolized Coxiella exposure.
claim_audit.chronic_endocarditis: Preexisting valvular disease plus prolonged culture-negative endocarditis is a classic chronic Q fever presentation.
claim_audit.serology: High phase I IgG supports chronic rather than acute Q fever.
claim_audit.key_intracellular_niche: Coxiella uniquely tolerates and replicates in an acidified phagolysosome-like vacuole.
claim_audit.listeria_distractor: Listeria uses listeriolysin-mediated phagosomal escape into the cytosol.
claim_audit.mycobacteria_distractor: Mycobacterium tuberculosis classically inhibits phagolysosomal maturation/fusion.
claim_audit.chlamydia_distractor: Chlamydia uses elementary- and reticulate-body developmental forms in intracellular inclusions.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Ignoring the staged key, livestock-parturition exposure, valvular disease, culture-negative endocarditis, and phase I IgG establish chronic Q fever. The organism's defining intracellular adaptation among the choices is replication in an acidic phagolysosome-like vacuole.
adversarial_second_pass.bartonella_attack: Bartonella can also cause culture-negative endocarditis, but the specific livestock/parturition exposure and phase I Coxiella serology remove that ambiguity.
adversarial_second_pass.brucella_attack: Brucella is associated with livestock and intracellular survival, but the phase I antibody clue and Coxiella-specific chronic endocarditis pattern distinguish it.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: All options describe real intracellular microbial strategies at similar granularity.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No treatment duration, exact antibody threshold, incubation period, or prevalence is required for the key.
